headline: Government Returns Enhanced Financial Monitoring of Former PEPs — Finance.ua
summary: Government bill No. 16051 has been registered in Ukraine's parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, to restore enhanced financial monitoring of former politically exposed persons.
why: Anti-money-laundering rules for politically exposed persons affect banks' compliance costs and cross-border capital flows.
